subject: Business Models
title: Super Apps
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Super Apps.

hook.text: WeChat in China is a marketplace, bank, social network, and messaging app in one. 1.3 billion users.

buildup.text: Super apps combine multiple marketplaces into one interface: food, rides, payments, shopping, all inside one app.

discovery.text: Grab in Southeast Asia started with rides, added food, payments, and insurance. One app for daily life.

twist.text: Western super apps keep failing. Uber, PayPal, and Facebook all tried and couldn't replicate the Asian model.

climax.text: Super apps work where mobile internet leapfrogged desktop. Western users already have specialized apps.

punchline.text: One app for everything. It works in Asia but the West resists.

quiz.question: Why have Western super app attempts failed?
options: Western users already have specialized apps for each need
